rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_messaging table, then drops delivery_receipt, suppression_entry, consent_record, campaign and template_version and the northstar_messaging schema (CASCADE). suppression_entry and consent_record record a recipient's opt-out/consent (a compliance-relevant marketing block), and delivery_receipt is the idempotency ledger that prevents duplicate provider submissions, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place. Published template versions are immutable, so this migration never mutates data in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_messaging schema with template_version, campaign, consent_record, suppression_entry and delivery_receipt tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_messaging table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 6 messaging module (transactional/marketing classification, versioned immutable templates, approved-attribute segmentation, recipient-timezone scheduling, always-honoured consent/suppression, idempotent provider submission, privacy-safe tracking) baseline
